title: Bring Distinctive from Papyrus 5.73.0 to 5.130.2 in seven stages, then lift the monitoring hold
description:
Plan (2026-11-17, planning only; nothing bumped, merged, deployed or written to a live site). Full text: docs/distinctive-bump-plan.md in the Papyrus repository (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#1667). Supersedes the 2026-11-07 draft epic dist-0c135b9b, which stopped at 5.92.0.

Why now: the shared procedure runner is on Papyrus 5.130 and refuses a start that has no wake key. The monitoring router still starts procedures directly, so the next new TTAB decision (collection once a day at 02:58 UTC, router at minute 41 of every hour) is refused. The papyrus-monitoring stack is held (PPY-e713eb); lifting it moves the router onto per-site wake queues for every site, and a site has its queue only once it is on 5.130. Distinctive is the first thing the hold waits for.

Stages, derived by running the real GSI ledger and release-budget code between stable tags (one index change per table per stage): S1 5.85.2, S2 5.86.0, S3 5.102.0, S4 5.107.2, S5 5.109.0, S6 5.112.1, S7 5.130.2. Each stage is a pin pull request into develop and its own release (develop into main, merge commit). S6 creates 23 indexes (about 54 minutes by the Machines on Machines measurement); the app has no _BUILD_TIMEOUT so Amplify stops it at 30 minutes, hence the app-shell task before it. S7 carries the 5.130 contract: generated build spec, procedure kind headers and papyrus-site-procedures.json, agents stack and wake queue.

Verification after every stage: CI and deploy green, Amplify job SUCCEED, root stack UPDATE_COMPLETE, each new index ACTIVE, sitemap still 42 URLs and five sample pages with the same text, newsroom sign-in and lists load, router and collector still clean.
Stop rule: a job not SUCCEED, a stack rolling back or in progress past twice its estimate, an index not ACTIVE past twice its estimate, a lost URL or an unloadable newsroom stops everything and goes to Ryan; no retry loop. Rollback is a pull request restoring the pins; indexes and tables stay.
Timing: nothing between 02:50 and 03:50 UTC; S7 and the hold lift finish in one UTC day before 02:58 UTC.

Acceptance:
Scenario: Distinctive is current
  Given the stage tasks are done in order
  When the last stage is deployed
  Then the pins, both lock files and requirements-publication.txt say 5.130.2 and every stage check passed
Scenario: The hold can be lifted
  Given Distinctive is on 5.130.2, its automations are adopted, and its router config names tenantId and siteBucket
  When the papyrus-monitoring hold is lifted
  Then a new TTAB decision starts the ruling analysis through the wake queue
